description: Where the initial claims figures for this week come from: ETA 539 (DOL's official weekly report), news release, advance (newest week) or news release, revised
how_calculated: src/fetchers/dol_recent_weeks.py

description: Where the continued claims figures for this week come from (same values as source_initial; continued claims lag initial claims by a week)
how_calculated: src/fetchers/dol_recent_weeks.py

description: Continued weeks claimed, regular state UI programs (sum of all states, ar539 c8)
how_calculated: Sum of ar539 cw_state_ui over all areas by reflected week; blank unless every area reported

description: Continued weeks claimed, Extended Benefits (sum of all states)
how_calculated: Sum of ar539 cw_eb_total over all areas by reflected week; blank unless every area reported

description: Continued weeks claimed, state additional benefit programs (sum of all states)
how_calculated: Sum of ar539 cw_state_additional_total over all areas by reflected week; blank unless every area reported

description: Continued weeks claimed, all programs: regular state + UCFE + UCX + EB + state additional + STC/workshare
how_calculated: Sum of the cw_ program columns; blank unless every program total is available

description: Where the initial claims figures for this week come from (ETA 539 or news release, advance / revised)
how_calculated: src/fetchers/dol_recent_weeks.py

description: Where the continued claims figures for this week come from (ETA 539 or news release, advance / revised)
how_calculated: src/fetchers/dol_recent_weeks.py

description: SA initial claims rate: seasonally adjusted initial claims as a percent of covered employment (the site shows this x 100 = per 10,000 covered workers)
how_calculated: ic_sa / covered_employment x 100

description: NSA initial claims rate: not seasonally adjusted initial claims as a percent of covered employment
how_calculated: ic_nsa / covered_employment x 100

description: 4-week average of the SA initial claims rate (percent)
how_calculated: Mean of the latest 4 weekly ic_rate_sa values

description: 4-week average of the NSA initial claims rate (percent)
how_calculated: Mean of the latest 4 weekly ic_rate_nsa values

description: SA continuing claims rate: seasonally adjusted continued claims as a percent of covered employment (matches DOL's insured unemployment rate within rounding)
how_calculated: cc_sa / covered_employment x 100

description: NSA continuing claims rate: not seasonally adjusted continued claims as a percent of covered employment
how_calculated: cc_nsa / covered_employment x 100

description: 4-week average of the SA continuing claims rate (percent)
how_calculated: Mean of the latest 4 weekly cc_rate_sa values

description: 4-week average of the NSA continuing claims rate (percent)
how_calculated: Mean of the latest 4 weekly cc_rate_nsa values

description: DOL's published insured unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted (percent, 1 decimal), for comparison
how_calculated: From the ETA 539 national report / FRED IURSA

description: First payments, state UI (ar5159 c51), for the month
how_calculated: From ar5159; US = sum of all areas

description: Final payments (claimants who exhausted benefits), state UI (ar5159 c56), for the month
how_calculated: From ar5159; US = sum of all areas

description: Weeks compensated, all weeks, state UI (ar5159 c38), for the month
how_calculated: From ar5159; US = sum of all areas

description: 12-month exhaustion rate (percent): share of claimants who use up their state benefits
how_calculated: 12-month average final payments / 12-month average first payments lagged 6 months x 100 (DOL definition)

description: Average benefit duration (weeks), all claimants
how_calculated: 12-month weeks compensated / 12-month first payments (DOL definition)
